settings.title: Platinum
settings.text: Platinum feels substantial, naturally white, and enduring for engagement rings made for daily wear.

settings.title: Yellow and white gold
settings.text: 18K yellow gold brings a rich champagne warmth; 18K white gold keeps the look crisp and luminous.

settings.title: Rose gold
settings.text: Rose gold adds a romantic warmth that can soften modern settings and vintage-inspired silhouettes.

settings.heading: Choose the tone that frames your diamond
settings.subheading: Metal changes the entire mood of a ring, from platinum restraint to the warmth of 18K yellow or rose gold.
settings.cta_heading: Unsure which metal suits your stone?
settings.cta_text: Tell us your preferred diamond shape, skin tone preference, and wear habits. We will guide the metal choice.
